Records.description: Basso-Dixon fishnet family, basso-dixon_L2x2_massless-internal-offshell-external. Basso-Dixon fishnet B_{M,N}: an M x N rectangular grid, 4 external operators at the corners, defined in dual (region-momentum) space via products of 1/x_ij^2 propagators. The L = MN loop integral is conformal. Momentum space: the (M+1) x (N+1) vertex grid (2MN+M+N massless edges, 4 off-shell corner legs, MN loops); B_{M,1} = the M-rung 4-pt ladder; transpose symmetry fixes the canonical orientation M >= N.

Results.normalization: Exact $2\times2$ Basso--Dixon fishnet: the convention-free conformal determinant of Usyukina--Davydychev ladders (arXiv:1705.03545, Eqs. 1--6), $\Phi^{(1)}\Phi^{(3)}-\frac{1}{3}\,(\Phi^{(2)})^2$, weight-8 explicit classical polylogarithms in the conformal cross-ratios $z,\bar z$. The numeric is its value at $z=1/3$, $\bar z=1/5$.

import.method: Basso-Dixon fishnet B_{M,N}: convention-free conformal determinant det[c_ij Phi^(M-N-1+i+j)(z,zbar)] of Usyukina-Davydychev ladders, evaluated at z=1/3, zbar=1/5. The slice B_{M,1} reduces exactly to the M-rung 4-point ladder Phi^(M).
